task.title: Durable subagent freshness and worker progress recovery

intent.goal: Make new Codex subagent activity visible promptly and make the telemetry worker recover automatically when its control loop stops advancing.
must_happen: A SubagentStart hook discovers the new subagent rollout even when the hook payload has no agent transcript path and the Codex SQLite row is not visible yet.
A telemetry worker whose control loop stops making progress is detected within a bounded interval and terminates non-zero so Railway can replace it.
Existing primary-session discovery, immutable raw uploads, transient database recovery, and dedicated GitHub sync isolation remain intact.
must_not_happen: Do not rewrite, delete, or mutate previously captured raw telemetry.
Do not create duplicate logical sessions or upload duplicate bytes merely because fallback discovery is enabled.
Do not restart a healthy worker during normal idle polling, active job processing, or GitHub synchronization.
Do not require additional database or compute capacity to recover from a wedged worker.
constraints: Collector hooks must remain bounded under the existing 30-second plugin timeout.
The production topology remains one Railway telemetry-processor replica.
The fix must compose with PR #75 database recovery and PR #76 GitHub sync isolation.
non_goals: Changing Supabase size or Railway compute allocation.
Redesigning dashboard product queries or canonical telemetry schemas.
Deploying, restarting, backfilling, or otherwise mutating production in this implementation step.
open_questions: The exact current Codex SubagentStart payload shape is not persisted; the fix must tolerate both legacy payloads with agent_transcript_path and current payloads without it.
assumptions: Codex writes subagent rollout files beneath ~/.codex/sessions with session_meta.id, session_meta.source, and parent/root identifiers; this was observed directly for Caleb's active subagent.
Railway restarts a one-replica service after a non-zero worker exit under its existing restart policy.

proof_obligations.claim: SubagentStart promptly discovers a newly written subagent rollout without depending on a transcript path in the hook payload or an already-visible SQLite thread row.
proof_obligations.verification: A regression fixture with a root payload, no agent_transcript_path, no matching SQLite row, and a recent subagent rollout fails before the change and passes afterward; existing discovery tests also pass.

proof_obligations.claim: A worker with a stalled control loop invokes bounded fatal recovery, while a healthy loop remains running.
proof_obligations.verification: Deterministic unit tests with an injected clock/fatal callback prove stale progress triggers exactly once and fresh progress does not trigger.

proof_obligations.claim: The fixes preserve raw immutability and the existing database-recovery and GitHub-isolation behavior.
proof_obligations.verification: Focused collector and worker suites plus the relevant broader package tests pass, and an independent integration review finds no boundary regression.

proof_obligations.claim: The implementation stays operationally bounded and has an explicit rollback path.
proof_obligations.verification: Review confirms recent-file discovery retains existing age/count bounds, the watchdog threshold exceeds normal control-loop work, configuration is validated, and rollback is limited to reverting the code/config changes.
